Judging the Judges: A Tiny Test Paper

Abstract.

Abstract

We study how language models grade other models.

1. Introduction

Evaluation is hard (Zheng et al., 2023).

Our contributions are:

  1. A benchmark of judge agreement.

  2. A bias correction method.

2. Method

We compare judges against human raters.

2.1. Position Bias

Judges prefer the first answer shown.

2.1.1. Swapping

Swapping the order reduces the bias.
